spans.text: If the request is ambiguous, ask questions.
spans.note: The prompt encourages asking clarifying questions when requests are ambiguous, which supports truthfulness and avoids fabrication. It instructs the system to think step-by-step and explain changes, promoting transparency in reasoning.

spans.text:
if you need to propose edits to existing files not already added to the chat, you *MUST* tell the user their full path names and ask them to *add the files to the chat*.
End your reply and wait for their approval.
spans.note: The prompt explicitly preserves user agency by requiring the system to ask for user approval before editing files not already in the chat, and to ask clarifying questions for ambiguous requests. This keeps consequential actions under user control.
